description: Each method+path must match the shipped router; UI support describes present functionality, not proposed P21 features. Expert API-only functions are deliberately not represented as existing browser controls.

groups.detail: Chat admission, durable turns, retries, context, steps and generation are available in the chat/agent-activity UI; no private reasoning is exposed.
Imported-memory inbox and inline candidate review; status and retrieval rehearsal also appear in chat.
Sanitized history search and privacy actions, export review/release, and evidence-linked external sessions; unavailable transcript remains unavailable.
Jobs, retry, registered process controls, and read-only Git state; health is shown in workspace connection/status.
Scope and canonical root can be saved through typed paths. The allowlisted server-side directory browser exists in P21-T06, but the reviewed folder-picker UI is P21-T07.

Authenticated read-only directory browsing is implemented and allowlisted, but remains an API-only backend contract until P21-T07 adds the reviewed owner folder picker. It never grants permissions or mutates a scope.

Model roles load exact IDs only from the selected provider's /models response, expose accessible suggestions for main/extraction/verification, keep manual exact IDs as an explicit fallback for empty/error discovery, preserve configured role values across provider switches, and never infer model capabilities from discovery.
Browser assets/entry point are delivered to render the UI; they are not standalone owner actions.

Providers & secrets lists the environment and saved profiles, shows the selected provider, and provides reviewed add/edit/test/select/delete controls. API keys are write-only and are never returned by GET or persisted in browser storage; deleting a selected provider is refused until another profile is selected.

Raw chat submission and external producer event ingestion are authenticated integration surfaces used by clients/producers rather than standalone owner configuration actions. Their user-visible effects are covered by the Chat and External development sessions UI rather than exposing raw request builders.
Advanced incident comparison, coverage, provenance, audit/graph exports and deployment provenance are API/operator functions; no equivalent complete browser control is claimed.
Governance/branch management and full recovery health are backend APIs; no complete self-service UI is claimed.
Machine-readable export import and exact-original archive management require expert/API workflows; the current UI supports distinct sanitized transcript import and reviewed history export only.
